payload.text: **hv, 26 Oct: VCs up now, builders only when their project is called.** One project at a time runs its heavy work directly, with no slot desk, and a kovacs leg counts as heavy. molt-vc coordinates; while two projects overlap, their VCs send molt-vc START and END. The order molt-vc proposed: Molt, Devbin, Utilz, Intent, Gtools, Conflab, Laksa.
